thread:
**Issue #3803 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3803: CI: a job ran over 7 minutes
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[CI run 43276797892](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43276797892) on `bot/issue-3777` (`8a8dfa5`, pull_request) had jobs over the 7-minute alert (#73):

| Job | Time | Result |
|---|---|---|
| [e2e smoke (1/2)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43276797892/job/131444367892) | 8m 13s | success |
| [e2e smoke (2/2)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43276797892/job/131444367943) | 7m 32s | success |

Split the slow job further until every job finishes under the 5-minute target, not just under the 7-minute alert, so the fix has headroom. Most splits are a count in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` (#3072): `web (unit k/K)`, `e2e smoke (k/K)` (for e2e, also refresh the `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`), or a `rust (test <group>)` group, whose count runs its tests in that many jobs, split by name. A count splits the run, not the compile: a group slow to compile needs its tests in more binaries (the engine's `rules_<n>` each get a job by themselves). Anything that cannot be made fast belongs in the daily `.github/workflows/super.yml`, not in CI.

Night bot: you cannot change `.github/`, and a count or a new `rules_<n>` needs no change there. When the split needs a new group or other flags in `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`, or any other change under `.github/`, make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/ci-duration.yml`._

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43301377963)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Issue #3803 reports `e2e smoke (1/2)` at 8m 13s and `(2/2)` at 7m 32s. Those ran with two shards on `bot/issue-3777`. `main` already holds the fix, #3765 (`eef28c3240`), which sets `smoke = 4` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml`. It also updates `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` to pin four shards, and `ci.yml` now runs `bot selftest` when `scripts/ci-shards.toml` changes.

I can't see any run on the four-shard layout, so I can't tell whether each shard finishes under 5 minutes. The only change I can make here is to correct the stale comment above `[e2e]` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml`. A count above 4 cannot be shipped by the bot (see Open questions).

## Files to touch

| File | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/ci-shards.toml` | change | Rewrite the comment above `[e2e]` / `smoke = 4`. It names "seven SMOKE specs" and a deal that no longer matches. `SMOKE` now has eight specs, with `51` added. |

The builder must not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` (including `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`), `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`, or any crate or app. No spec section or ruling governs this change. The `WEIGHTS` are not refreshed because no measured times are available. Changing them with no data would be guessing.

## Steps

1. In `scripts/ci-shards.toml`, replace the comment block directly above `[e2e]`. Leave `smoke = 4` and every other line untouched. I computed the current deal with `cd e2e && node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke <k> 4` for k = 1..4. These are the specs that command prints for each shard:
   - 1: `47`
   - 2: `46`
   - 3: `06`, `10`, `13`, `19`
   - 4: `01`, `51`

   The new comment says:
   - With 2 shards the smoke specs ran 8m 7s and 8m 57s (#3764), and 8m 13s and 7m 32s on `bot/issue-3777` (#3803).
   - The count is now 4 (#3765). `shardSpecs` deals the eight SMOKE specs (`e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`) in the four shards listed above.
   - Specs `46`, `47` and `51` are still estimates in `WEIGHTS`. Refresh `WEIGHTS` from the first `e2e smoke (k/4)` timings on `main`.
   - The count may not exceed the 8 SMOKE specs, and 8 is the cap (`matrix.py`'s `MAX_SHARDS`).
   - A count above 4 also needs `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` lines 75 and 122 changed by a person, because the test pins the live count at `[1, 2, 3, 4]`.
2. Run `cd e2e && node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke 1 4` and confirm it prints a spec list. Check that the comment's deal matches what the command prints for all four shards.

## Tests

No new test. The count did not change, so the existing pin in `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` keeps passing. Run:
- `cd bot && python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_matrix` (unset `HARNESS_HOME` and `HARNESS_DRY_RUN` first).
- `cd e2e && for k in 1 2 3 4; do node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke $k 4; echo; done`.

## Done when

- [ ] The `[e2e]` comment in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` matches the real deal and the eight SMOKE specs.
- [ ] `smoke = 4` is unchanged and no file other than `scripts/ci-shards.toml` is in the diff.
- [ ] The `test_ci_matrix` run above passes.
- [ ] The harness checks (fmt, clippy, cargo tests and the others) pass unchanged.
- [ ] The final report says plainly that the issue's run predates #3765 and that no four-shard timing was seen.

## Risks

- A wrong edit to the TOML breaks `.github/ci/matrix.py` and fails the `changes` job, and with it every check. Edit comments only, and run the `test_ci_matrix` command above.
- Raising `smoke` to 5 or more makes `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py:75` fail. The bot may not edit that file, so don't do it.
- Spec `47` (est. 200 s) and spec `46` (est. 180 s) each sit alone in their shard, so splitting further cannot speed those shards. The other two shards (about 169 s and 172 s of spec time) are also bounded by their longest spec plus fixed setup.

## Open questions

- Has any `e2e smoke (k/4)` job run since #3765, and did every shard finish under 5 minutes? If a shard is still over, a person needs to do these:
  1. Edit `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`. Change the assertion on line 75 to the new count list, and make the `smoke = 4` / `smoke = 5` edit in `test_a_count_on_a_fanned_out_group_shards_each_of_its_binaries` (lines 120–122) and the line-134 case match it.
  2. Then raise `smoke` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` and refresh `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs` from the measured Cypress durations of `46`, `47` and `51`.
  3. If one spec alone still takes over 5 minutes, move that spec from `SMOKE` to the daily `super.yml` run, which is also a person's job because it edits `.github/workflows/`.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
```
